samples.prompt: user: My Node service crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined at startup. Where should I look first?
samples.response:
Root cause: Accessing a property on an undefined variable at startup.
Patch: Check the exact line in the stack trace where the error occurs.
Next check: Verify all variables used on that line are properly initialized before access, especially environment variables, config objects, or dependencies loaded at startup.

samples.prompt: user: My Node service crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined at startup. Where should I look first?
samples.response: Start by identifying the exact line causing the error from the stack trace. Check the code at startup where you access object properties—ensure the object is properly initialized before use. Add console.log statements before the error line to verify variable states. Also, review any asynchronous code or configuration files loaded at startup that might be undefined. Fix the root cause by ensuring all dependencies and variables are defined before accessing their properties.

samples.prompt: user: My deadline is tomorrow and I am behind. Give me a strict triage plan for today.
samples.response: To maximize your productivity today and meet your deadline, follow this strict triage plan: 1. Prioritize Tasks: List all remaining tasks and identify those critical for the minimum viable deliverable. 2. Time Allocation: Divide your available hours into focused work blocks (e.g., 90 minutes) with short breaks (10-15 minutes) to maintain energy. 3. Eliminate Distractions: Turn off notifications, close unrelated tabs/apps, and inform others you need uninterrupted time. 4. Quick Wins First: Start with tasks that can be completed quickly to build momentum. 5. Delegate if Possible: Identify any tasks that can be handed off to teammates. 6. Review and Adjust: At midday, assess progress and adjust priorities if needed. 7. Final Hour: Reserve the last hour for testing, review, and packaging your work. Stay focused and keep hydrated. You can do this!
